resources.string: Manual records in the selected accounting currency. Opening balances are before all recorded expenses; negative balances are allowed. Recurring payments use Main account. Savings goals are separate from account balances.
Delete this record? Both sides of a transfer will be removed.

Estimate for the current month, not a guarantee. Average uses up to three completed months after the first recorded month; pace extrapolates spending through today. MAE measures errors on past completed months using the same cutoff day and only earlier data. Months without expenses count as zero. Incomplete records can distort results.
